newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA IPO FULLY UNDERWRITTEN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLIFARB DEBICA IPO FULLY UNDERWRITTEN.

text.p: Six firms have underwritten Polish paintmaker Polifarb Debica SA's whole 700,000-share initial public offering, which starts on Monday, the company said in a statement on Friday.
Polifarb Debica said Creditanstalt Securities SA brokerage and Creditanstalt Investment Bank AG underwrote 178,500 shares each and BIG underwrote 175,000 shares.
It said Polish Bank Handlowy SA brokerage, BPH and state-owned PKO BP underwrote 56,000 shares each.
It said the stand-by fee was two percent.
The company, which set the issue price at 65 zlotys per share, has earlier said it wants to start bourse trade in April.
Polifarb Debica expects its 1997 net profit to rise to 17 million zlotys on 148.1-million-zloty sales, up from 1996's net-profit estimate of 12.8 million zlotys on sales of 137.5 million zlotys.
